desktop_hover_preview: 250x350, Main Deck rows only, upward placement
desktop_right_panel_scroll: vertical allowed when needed; horizontal prohibited
card_review: Skill Card Review keeps the approved compact Class/Rank and metric/Skill Effect structure. DAMAGE and BLOCK values show Physical, Magical, or Physical / Magical beneath the number. Metric wording is not repeated in Skill Effect. Ultimate values remain white; labels remain gold.
header_guidance: Build your Legacy Deck first, then complete your Main Deck. Style switch is explicitly labeled as a CHANGE TO action.
filter_state: Independent per-tab filter state for Heroes, Legacies, Skills, Events, and Items. Skill Class filters never affect Event or Item results.
release_delta: Public package v1.14: both Style 1 and Style 2 require exactly 60 Main Deck cards before Export. Style 2 retains its 80-card temporary cutting workspace. Card definitions, starter data, and gameplay rules are unchanged.
